Haidian AI industry scale (core industry ~2822亿元 2024, 1900+ AI enterprises, 104 registered large models) and district GDP (~1.3万亿元); cited as verifiable public context for the industry/ecosystem research, not as statutory control.
Haidian education scale (~415,000 enrolled students, 181 primary/secondary schools, 220 kindergartens, 2024); supports the campus-adjacent innovation-street and talent-life-service scenario KPIs.

Distribution of universities and research institutes along the Xueyuan Road / Jing-Zhang corridor (Beijing Jiaotong, Beihang, USTB, CUGB, CUMTB, BLCU, BJFU, CAU, Tsinghua, PKU; CAS institutes); anchors the 'source/origin' ring of the innovation-ecosystem map.

Beijing rail-transit ridership context (network ~990万/day 2024; Line 13 peak ~160万/day; Line 13 A/B split adding ~19 stations); supports slow-mobility demand, station-integration, and AI+scenario KPI baselines.

Beijing-Zhangjiakou HSR operation (opened 2019-12-30; ~5742万 cumulative passengers to 2025-01; Qinghe station holiday peak ~4.45万/day); evidences the released ground rail corridor and the Qinghe tri-rail hub opportunity.
